title: Draft the first memory experiment contract
question: How can we measure whether memory helps across a sequence of tasks?
baseline: README.md, docs/stack.md, and docs/verification.md at the checked-out commit.
resources: A laptop, Python 3.11+, and access to public documentation. No GPU.
acceptance: Name one open reference agent or implementation with a primary source and license.
Define a memory-off baseline, fixed task sequence, and equal inference budget.
Define success, forgetting, false-memory, and poisoned-input checks.
State resources, repeats, a primary threshold, and an independent run procedure.
Mark commands as proposed unless run. Keep acceptance independent from the worker.
checks: Manually review every cited primary source.
evidence: Time spent, tool used, and unresolved questions.
stop_conditions: No suitable licensed baseline found; report the gap.
deliverable: A draft memory contract with clear checks and limits.
